abilities.name: Energy
abilities.description: Each time Zarya's Personal Barrier or Shield Ally absorbs 9 damage, her Energy is increased by 1. Each point of Energy increases Zarya's damage by 2%. After 0.5 seconds, Energy decays by 3 per second. Particle Cannon

fields.notes: Zarya's Basic Attacks Splash to all enemies in a 1.0 x 6.25 rectangle in front of her. Her main target must still be within her attack range. Splash cannot hit more than 4 times per second (even if Zarya's Attack Speed is increased). Splash hits 62.5ms (1 server tick) after the primary target is hit and does not happen if the primary target is killed by that Basic Attack.

abilities.name: Particle Grenade
abilities.description: Launch a particle grenade that deals 80 damage to enemies within the area. Deals 50% damage to Structures. Stores up to 4 charges.; 8 / 0.75

fields.notes: Structure damage penalty stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Particle Grenade 's damage.

abilities.name: Personal Barrier
abilities.description: Gain a Shield that absorbs 560 damage for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Shield Ally
abilities.description: Grants an allied Hero a Shield that absorbs 420 damage for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Graviton Surge
abilities.description: Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30 damage a second.; 60; Heroic

fields.notes: Graviton Surge pulls affected Heroes to within 1 radius of its center point and sets their Movement Speed to 0%. Affected Heroes can still attack and use their Abilities. Heroes can get out of Graviton Surge using Movement Abilities.

abilities.name: Expulsion Zone
abilities.description: Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124 damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.; 45; Heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Knockback, Slow

talents.name: Demolitions Expert
talents.description: quest For every 5 enemy Heroes hit by Particle Grenade, its recharge rate lowers by 0.4375 seconds, up to 3.5 seconds. Once Particle Grenade has hit 40 enemy Heroes, its radius is increased by 15%.
_raw_fields: quest For every 5 enemy Heroes hit by Particle Grenade, its recharge rate lowers by 0.4375 seconds, up to 3.5 seconds. Once Particle Grenade has hit 40 enemy Heroes, its radius is increased by 15%.

talents.name: Together We Are Strong
talents.description: For 3 seconds after gaining Shield Ally, every 5.35 damage done by the bearer contributes 1 Energy to Zarya, up to 40 Energy per Shield.
_raw_fields: For 3 seconds after gaining Shield Ally, every 5.35 damage done by the bearer contributes 1 Energy to Zarya, up to 40 Energy per Shield.

talents.name: Feel the Heat
talents.description: Zarya's Basic Attack deals 50% additional damage to enemies in melee range. While above 40 Energy, Zarya's Basic Attack size is increased by 35%.

fields.notes: Feel the Heat uses its own base damage value, which is 50% higher than the original, causing the given percentage to stack multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers.

_raw_fields: Zarya's Basic Attack deals 50% additional damage to enemies in melee range. While above 40 Energy, Zarya's Basic Attack size is increased by 35%.

talents.name: Maximum Charge
talents.description: Regen Globes now instantly grant 20 Energy. quest Spend 150 seconds at or above 50 Energy. Gain an additional 20 maximum Energy.

talents.name: I Am the Strongest

talents.name: Give Me Twenty
talents.description: quest Regeneration Globes increase Shield Ally value by 15, up to 300 permanently. After collecting 20 Regen Globes, permanently reduce the cooldown of Shield Ally by 2 seconds.

talents.name: Speed Barrier
talents.description: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.
_raw_fields: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.

talents.name: Defensive Shielding
talents.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier and Shield Ally grant 75 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks for 6 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack. If the target has certain Talents which give Block stacks (those Talents being Illidan with Reflexive Block, The Lost Vikings with Olaf the Stout, Muradin with Dwarf Block, Rexxar or Misha with Grizzled Fortitude), the Block stacks will be shared and capped at a maximum of 4. Additionally the duration of all Block stacks from either Talent will all be set to that of the most recently applied Block stacks.

_raw_fields: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier and Shield Ally grant 75 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks for 6 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

talents.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
talents.description: Particle Grenade deals 30 more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

fields.notes: Center radius is unaffected by Demolitions Expert bonus.

_raw_fields: Particle Grenade deals 30 more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

talents.name: Deep Burn
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Particle Grenade causes Basic Attacks against them to generate 2 Energy. Lasts 4 seconds.

fields.notes: If multiple Zaryas are on a team, they can all benefit from Deep Burn applied by another Zarya regardless of if they have the Talent or not.
